BiblicalUsage: Paraskeue is the Preparation, the day before the sabbath when everything was made ready. John 19:14 places the trial of Jesus at the sixth hour on the preparation of the passover, and John 19:31 and 19:42 show the Jews asking for the bodies to be taken down because it was the preparation. Mark 15:42 and Matthew 27:62 name the same day, the day that was the preparation, when Joseph of Arimathaea begged the body and the chief priests sealed the tomb.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the preparation day is where the cross is dated, and the irony is plain: men prepared for a sabbath while the Lamb of God was being prepared for burial. My position is that God was preparing something else that day, the rest that would break open on the third morning.
RelatedEvents: The Crucifixion; The Burial of Jesus
